conflicts.why: NCERT Biology p.111 says life appeared almost 4 billion years back; the same page says the first non-cellular forms could have originated 3 billion years back (p.112: first cellular ~2000 mya). A student learning 'when did life appear' vs 'when did the first non-cellular life originate' holds 4 bya and 3 bya. Keep the specific dated stages, hold the generic one.

p.220: card says Z is 0.1-0.2 'regardless of the taxonomic group or the region' (no scale context), while the continents card says Z is 0.6-1.2 for very large areas. The first only holds for smaller areas and does not say so. Hold it until it states 'for smaller areas' (or re-add with that context).

Principles of Inheritance p.72 card says deletions and insertions of base pairs cause frame-shift mutations with no qualifier; Molecular Basis p.98 says only 1 or 2 bases shift the frame, while 3 or multiples of 3 leave the reading frame unaltered. The p.72 card breaks the p.98 rule out of context.
